name: TKS Workspace Mount
description: Bind-mounts the host TKS workspace (~/Code/knowledge) into the container and symlinks it at $HOME/knowledge, so the container agent and host Obsidian read and write the same brains. TKS stores nothing under ~/.claude, so the claude-work Feature does not carry the workspace across: without this mount a container-side workspace would be a separate, Obsidian-invisible copy. Paired with dotfiles install.sh, which installs the tks CLI whenever this mount is present. Mount target is under /var to avoid being shadowed by /tmp tmpfs overlays (e.g., from docker-in-docker).
